0.name: DOHMH New York City Restaurant Inspection Results
0.note: The upstream source. The notebook does NOT call it. The curation tooling in dagspaces/common/curation/dohmh already got it, cleaned it, and wrote 2 files: the inspection-level restaurants.parquet and the 1-row-per-restaurant restaurants_aggregated.parquet.

1.name: DOHMH restaurants, aggregated by the curation tooling
1.note: The source of the 2 CONTEXT metrics. inspection_score reads last_score, thus its window is the LAST inspection of each unit. grade_a_rate reads n_grade_a over n_inspections, thus its window is the whole history. Holds the position too, so this case needs no network call and no name join. The uid matches unit_uid in the pairs manifest exactly. Build it again with: python -m dagspaces.common.curation aggregate-restaurants.

2.name: DOHMH inspection history, one row for each restaurant
2.note: The source of the HEADLINE metric, inspection_score_history. A sidecar of restaurants_aggregated.parquet: it adds no column to that file, and it joins on camis. It reads only the inspection type 'Cycle Inspection / Initial Inspection', because the city gives a re-inspection ONLY after a failure and a re-inspection score is thus conditional. 45,344 inspections over 21,537 restaurants; 16,271 restaurants hold 2 or more. Build it with: from dagspaces.common.curation.dohmh import build_inspection_history.

3.name: Open Restaurants / Dining Out NYC outdoor-dining licenses
3.note: The source of the outdoor_dining channel. The curation tooling in dagspaces/common/curation/open_restaurants already got it, so the notebook makes no network call. The license table carries no CAMIS, thus the join runs on BIN plus the normalized trade name, with a BIN-only fallback where the building holds exactly 1 restaurant. Of the 1,309 issued licenses, 1,273 reach a restaurant, and 1,076 of the 26,973 restaurants (4.0%) carry the flag. WARNING: this is a CONFOUNDER of the preference judgment, not a validation. Outdoor seating is visible from the street, thus the model can see it. Build it again with: python -m dagspaces.common.curation open-restaurants.
